audit.whatIsWrong: There is no full-layer entry for this matchup at all — CHAMP_FULL[nautilus][masteryi] does not exist, so diff, diffRating, carryRating, tone, tldr, winCon, the phases[] chart, every breakdown and all fifteen report sections are absent.
audit.why: currentText.full is null in the brief. This is one of the repo's 92 matchups with no full layer. Difficulty cannot be recorded on a page that has no difficulty field, and I will not create a fifteen-section report from scratch under a length band that has no 'before' to measure against — that is a page-build, not an audit edit.
audit.corrected: Flagged for a full-layer build. Based on the content layer, the honest reading is EVEN at roughly 5.5/10 with a high carry threat: Nautilus owns levels 1-3 outright and loses everything after Yi's first item, with a 50.07% win rate over 765 Emerald+ games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's spikes[] has three entries where four are expected, and the missing one is Highlander — the ability that ends Nautilus's ability to peel at all.
audit.why: spikes[] runs Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6, Full tank core and never mentions his ultimate. enemyKit R: 'temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects', 85s cooldown, extended by kills and assists. Riptide is Nautilus's only kiting tool and Highlander turns it off completely — that is a genuine power spike and it belongs on the page.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and spikes[3].when created with before:null, stating Highlander's slow immunity and which of your tools still hold him. The level chart itself already matches the packet row for row in both directions, so no chart edits were needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike is described only as a dash that 'dodges' the hook, never as untargetability — and untargetable is what makes a spent Depth Charge worthless rather than merely mistimed. Meditate is not mentioned anywhere, despite being a channel that heals him on a flat 10s cooldown and that any of Nautilus's CC cancels outright.
audit.why: enemyKit Q: 'teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed ... while simultaneously becoming untargetable', 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s, and 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown' — so the 20s is a ceiling, not a clock. enemyKit W: 'restoring Health and taking reduced damage', 10s, carrying both the heal and channel flags — the missingInteractions file flags untargetable-dodges-burst and needs-antiheal for exactly this pairing. Interrupting Meditate is the single highest-value thing Nautilus's CC does in this lane and the page never says so.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike's 20s rank-1 cooldown and untargetability written into mid and whys[5]; Meditate named as an interruptible channel in whys[4] and mid; Wuju Style's true damage and Highlander's slow immunity stated in whys[6] and the new spikes[3].
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R text, cooldowns and flags

edits.after: Highlander makes him immune to every slow for its duration, so Riptide stops peeling — only your hook, passive root and Depth Charge still hold him.

edits.before: At 6 your Depth Charge interrupts his combos, keeping the fight even until his scaling arrives.
edits.after: At 6 Depth Charge interrupts Meditate's channel and his combo — even, until his scaling arrives.

edits.before: At his first item he out-DPSes your tank frame and dodges the telegraphed hook — the duel is now his.
edits.after: At his first item he out-DPSes your tank frame and goes untargetable through the hook — the duel is his.

edits.before: Late his Highlander and true damage kill straight through Titan's Wrath and he out-splits you — never chase him alone.
edits.after: Late, Wuju Style's true damage and slow-immune Highlander kill through your shield and he out-splits you — never chase alone.

edits.before: From 4-5 he starts holding Alpha Strike to dodge your hook, so throw Q only after his dash is burned. At 6 Depth Charge is your equalizer — flatten him mid-combo the moment he commits. You are even here, not ahead: keep him poor and behind rather than gambling on solo kill attempts.
edits.after: From 4-5 he holds Alpha Strike — 20s at rank 1, and untargetable in flight — to dodge your hook, so throw Q only after it is burned. At 6 Depth Charge is your equalizer: it interrupts Meditate's channel outright. You are even here, not ahead: keep him poor rather than gambling on solo kills.
